##### Project general facts

Parkside Hills is a contemporary residential development that combines modern architecture with a tranquil, green setting. The project offers an urban lifestyle surrounded by landscaped greenery, with apartments designed to provide panoramic views of the community and its natural surroundings. Higher floors offer views of the iconic Burj Khalifa.

The development features contemporary architecture that blends with the surrounding green landscape. Its design emphasises panoramic views and a comfortable residential environment, while its location provides convenient access to Dubai's shopping, dining, business, and leisure destinations.

The apartments feature refined interiors with earthy colour tones and premium finishes, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Each residence comes with an equipped kitchen and is offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their living spaces according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills Estate is a master-planned mixed-use community within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, strategically located between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina. With access to Al Khail Road, the area offers convenient connections to key districts and attractions across the city.

The community offers a range of lifestyle amenities, including Dubai Hills Park, an 18-hole championship golf course, Dubai Hills Mall, and world-class healthcare and educational facilities. These destinations support a convenient lifestyle with opportunities for recreation, shopping, and everyday needs.

Umm Suqeim Road and Al Khail Road provide access to Downtown Dubai and other major business, retail, and tourism hubs. Planned Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro connections are also expected to improve connectivity to airports and other emirates in the future.
